source.author: verg
source.text: Iam gravis aequabat luctus et mutua Mavors funera: caedebant pariter pariterque ruebant victores victique, neque his fuga nota neque illis.
source.text_original: Iam gravis aequabat luctus et mutua Mavors / funera: caedebant pariter pariterque ruebant / victores victique, neque his fuga nota neque illis.
source.text_english: Now heavy sorrow was leveling the slaughter, and Mars was dealing mutual deaths: the victors and the vanquished were falling in equal measure, and in equal measure were they rushing to ruin, neither to these nor to those was flight known.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: acies pari fronte concurrunt, summa ui utrimque pugnatur: neque his fuga nota neque illis.
reuse.text_original: acies pari fronte concurrunt, summa ui utrimque pugnatur: neque his fuga nota neque illis.
reuse.text_english: The battle lines meet with equal front; on both sides they fight with the utmost force: neither are flight known to these men nor to those.
